questions.stem: Expand and simplify \[\begin{gathered}(x-3 y) \\ \cdot (2 x+y) \\ -(2 x^{2}+4 y^{2})\end{gathered}\]
questions.stemZh: 展開並化簡 \[\begin{gathered}(x-3 y) \\ \cdot (2 x+y) \\ -(2 x^{2}+4 y^{2})\end{gathered}\]
questions.solution: Expand each product using the distributive law, then collect like terms: \[\begin{gathered}(x-3 y) \\ \cdot (2 x+y) \\ -(2 x^{2}+4 y^{2}) \\ = 2 x^{2} - 5 x y \\ - 3 y^{2} \\ + (- 2 x^{2} - 4 y^{2}) \\ = - 5 x y - 7 y^{2}\end{gathered}\] Source-key correction: the supplied brief answer is \(4x^2-5xy+y^2\), which does not equal the given expression. The result above follows the original question unchanged.
questions.solutionZh: 用分配律展開每個乘積，再合併同類項：\[\begin{gathered}(x-3 y) \\ \cdot (2 x+y) \\ -(2 x^{2}+4 y^{2}) \\ = 2 x^{2} - 5 x y \\ - 3 y^{2} \\ + (- 2 x^{2} - 4 y^{2}) \\ = - 5 x y - 7 y^{2}\end{gathered}\]原卷簡答更正：原簡答為 \(4x^2-5xy+y^2\)，與原式不相等。以上結果按原題計算，沒有更改題目條件。

questions.stemZh: 展開並化簡 \[\begin{gathered}(3 x^{2}-y^{2}) \\ +(4 x-7 y) \\ \cdot (2 x+y)\end{gathered}\]

questions.stem:
(a) Simplify \[\begin{gathered}(5 x^{3}-x^{2}+x-1) \\ -(7 x^{2}+5)\end{gathered}\]
(b) Find the value of the polynomial when \(x=-2\).
questions.stemZh:
(a) 化簡 \[\begin{gathered}(5 x^{3}-x^{2}+x-1) \\ -(7 x^{2}+5)\end{gathered}\]
(b) 當 \(x=-2\) 時，求該多項式的值。
questions.solution:
(a) Expand each product using the distributive law, then collect like terms: \[\begin{gathered}(5 x^{3}-x^{2}+x-1) \\ -(7 x^{2}+5) \\ = 5 x^{3} \\ + (- x^{2}) + x \\ + (-1) \\ + (- 7 x^{2} - 5) \\ = 5 x^{3} - 8 x^{2} \\ + x - 6\end{gathered}\]
(b) Substitute \(x=-2\): \[\begin{gathered}5 x^{3} - 8 x^{2} \\ + x - 6 = -80\end{gathered}\]

questions.stem:
(a) Simplify \[\begin{gathered}(6 a^{2}-5 a b-b^{2}) \\ +(a b-b^{2}) \\ -(7 a b+5 a^{2}-b^{2})\end{gathered}\]
(b) Find the value of the polynomial when \(a=-1, b=-2\).
questions.stemZh:
(a) 化簡 \[\begin{gathered}(6 a^{2}-5 a b-b^{2}) \\ +(a b-b^{2}) \\ -(7 a b+5 a^{2}-b^{2})\end{gathered}\]
(b) 當 \(a=-1, b=-2\) 時，求該多項式的值。
questions.solution:
(a) Expand each product using the distributive law, then collect like terms: \[\begin{gathered}(6 a^{2}-5 a b-b^{2}) \\ +(a b-b^{2}) \\ -(7 a b+5 a^{2}-b^{2}) \\ = 6 a^{2} \\ + (- 5 a b) \\ + (- b^{2}) + a b \\ + (- b^{2}) \\ + (- 5 a^{2} - 7 a b + b^{2}) \\ = a^{2} - 11 a b \\ - b^{2}\end{gathered}\]
(b) Substitute \(a=-1, b=-2\): \[\begin{gathered}a^{2} - 11 a b \\ - b^{2} = -25\end{gathered}\]

questions.stem:
(a) Simplify \[\begin{gathered}2 x y^{3} (x-5 y^{2}) \\ +5 x y^{2} (x^{2}+x y+y^{3})\end{gathered}\]
(b) Find the coefficient of \(x^{2} y^{3}\) in the expansion in (a).
(c) Find the degree of the expansion in (a).
questions.stemZh:
(a) 化簡 \[\begin{gathered}2 x y^{3} (x-5 y^{2}) \\ +5 x y^{2} (x^{2}+x y+y^{3})\end{gathered}\]
(b) 求 (a) 中展開式的 \(x^{2} y^{3}\) 項的係數。
(c) 求 (a) 中展開式的次數。
questions.solution:
(a) Expand each product using the distributive law, then collect like terms: \[\begin{gathered}2 x y^{3} (x-5 y^{2}) \\ +5 x y^{2} (x^{2}+x y+y^{3}) \\ = 2 x^{2} y^{3} \\ - 10 x y^{5} \\ + 5 x^{3} y^{2} \\ + 5 x^{2} y^{3} \\ + 5 x y^{5} \\ = 5 x^{3} y^{2} \\ + 7 x^{2} y^{3} \\ - 5 x y^{5}\end{gathered}\]
(b) Coefficient: \(7\). (c) Total degree: \(6\).

questions.stem: The remainder when a polynomial \(f(x)\) is divided by \(4x-6\) is \(8\). Find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(3-2x\).
questions.stemZh: 多項式 \(f(x)\) 被 \(4x-6\) 除時餘式為 \(8\)。求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(3-2x\) 除時的餘式。
questions.solution: Both \(4x-6=0\) and \(3-2x=0\) give \(x=\frac{3}{2}\). The divisors share the same root, so both remainders equal \(f(\frac{3}{2})=8\).
questions.solutionZh: \(4x-6=0\) 與 \(3-2x=0\) 都給 \(x=\frac{3}{2}\)。兩個除式有同一個 root，所以餘式同為 \(f(\frac{3}{2})=8\)。。

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=3x^2-kx-2\), where \(k\) is a constant. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(3x+1\), find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-k\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=3x^2-kx-2\)，其中 \(k\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(3x+1\) 整除，求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x-k\) 除時的餘式。
questions.solution: The factor \(3x+1\) gives \(x=-\frac{1}{3}\): \[ f\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)=\frac{1}{3}+\frac{k}{3}-2=0, \] so \(k=5\). The required remainder is \(f(5)=48\).

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=x^2-hx+k\), where \(h\) and \(k\) are constants. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(2x-h\), find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x+h\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=x^2-hx+k\)，其中 \(h,k\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(2x-h\) 整除，求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(2x+h\) 除時的餘式。
questions.solution: Since \(2x-h\) is a factor, \(f(\frac h2)=0\), giving \(k=\frac{h^2}{4}\). The root of \(2x+h\) is \(-\frac h2\), hence \[ f\left(-\frac h2\right)=\frac{h^2}{4}+\frac{h^2}{2}+\frac{h^2}{4}=h^2. \]
questions.solutionZh: \(2x-h\) 是因式，故 \(f(\frac h2)=0\)，所以 \[ \frac{h^2}{4}-\frac{h^2}{2}+k=0\Rightarrow k=\frac{h^2}{4}. \] 除式 \(2x+h\) 的 root 是 \(-\frac h2\)，故 \[ f\left(-\frac h2\right)=\frac{h^2}{4}+\frac{h^2}{2}+\frac{h^2}{4}=h^2. \] 。

questions.stem: Let \(p(x)=ax^4+4x^2-3x+b\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are non-zero constants. When \(p(x)\) is divided by \(3x-2\), the remainder is \(7\). Find the remainder when \(p(x)\) is divided by \(3x+2\).
questions.hint: The roots of \(3x-2\) and \(3x+2\) are \(\frac{2}{3}\) and \(-\frac{2}{3}\).
questions.solution: The roots of \(3x-2\) and \(3x+2\) are \(\frac{2}{3}\) and \(-\frac{2}{3}\). The even-power terms agree, while \(-3x\) increases by \(4\). Thus \[ p\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)=p\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)+4=11. \]
questions.solutionZh: \(3x-2\) 與 \(3x+2\) 的 root 分別是 \(\frac{2}{3}\) 與 \(-\frac{2}{3}\)。偶次項在兩個 input 的值相同；一次項 \(-3x\) 則由 \(-2\) 變為 \(2\)，增加 \(4\)。所以 \[ p\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)=p\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)+4=11. \] 。
